headline: REG's Q2 FFO Beat Estimates on Leasing Momentum, '26 View Raised
summary: Regency's Q2 FFO tops estimates as leasing momentum drives rent and occupancy gains, while stronger tenant recoveries lift its 2026 outlook.

headline: MarketAxess (MKTX) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
summary: MarketAxess (MKTX) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +3.72% and +0.49%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
